title: Stephanie Rizzi
description: Rizzi made a social media post claiming a link between police brutality and heart health in black women.
body:
# Stephanie Rizzi

# School Board Member

![](/media/uploads/2026/03/rizzi-profile.jpg)

- After Don Lemon **[was arrested](https://web.archive.org/web/20260320195047/https:/restoration-news.com/getmedia/e25b5b33-d8ba-4587-983c-2fd391fa78d7/VA-Rizzi-Don-Lemon.png)** for entering a Minnesota church with people terrorizing the congregation, Rizzi said, “His arrest greatly disturbs me.”
- Advocates for **[dismantling ICE](https://web.archive.org/save/https:/restoration-news.com/getmedia/1c1a2f16-6c46-49fc-88d6-36b16752b019/VA-Rizzi-dismantle-ICE.png)**.
- Made a **[social media post](https://web.archive.org/web/20260320195246/https:/restoration-news.com/getmedia/46d4b9a5-00d4-4a4d-96b9-255a524a0ca5/VA-Richmond-Rizzi-police-brutality.png)** claiming a link between police brutality and heart health in black women.

![](/media/uploads/2026/03/rizzi-social.png)

- At the RPS school board meeting **[on Oct 3, 2022](https://go.boarddocs.com/vsba/richmond/Board.nsf/Public)**, Rizzi voted **[to oppose](https://web.archive.org/web/20250911022041/https:/www.wtvr.com/news/local-news/richmond-school-leaders-oppose-new-transgender-polices-september-20-2022)** Youngkin’s Model Policies regarding transgender students that required students to use restrooms and locker rooms based on biological sex not gender identity.
